verdict.rationale: Qodo's own docs offer deployment models (single-tenant, on-premises, air-gapped) that let a customer run Qodo entirely within their own infrastructure, so they control where data lives. Nothing documents choosing a region or data-residency location within the hosted multi-tenant SaaS. missing for 10: region selection for hosted SaaS, explicit data-residency documentation (e.g. EU/US storage options), independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Deploy Qodo entirely within your own infrastructure.
